normative_extracts.quote: Grid track sizing initializes base sizes and growth limits, resolves intrinsic track sizes, maximizes tracks up to their limits, and finally expands flexible (fr) tracks.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: 1fr is shorthand for minmax(auto, 1fr); intrinsic minimum sizing runs before fr space division, causing grid blowout unless minmax(0, 1fr) is used.

production_failures.symptom: A 1fr grid column expands beyond the container when holding a wide code block or table
production_failures.root_cause: 1fr resolves to minmax(auto, 1fr), so its minimum track size is the child’s min-content width.
production_failures.mitigation: Write minmax(0, 1fr) instead of 1fr when tracks must stay bounded by the container.

production_failures.symptom: auto-fit vs auto-fill leaves unexpected empty space in sparse grids
production_failures.root_cause: auto-fill keeps empty implicit tracks at their minimum size, whereas auto-fit collapses empty tracks to 0px.
production_failures.mitigation: Use auto-fit to stretch items across the row, or auto-fill to preserve fixed column widths.
